question: Does default GASearchCV beat a same-budget random hyperparameter search?

settings.order: All GA searches were timed before all random searches; compare quality on paired splits, treat timing as descriptive.

reproduction_script:
"""Compare default HPO evolution with equal-budget random search on fixed splits."""

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import loguniform
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer, load_digits, make_classification
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.model_selection import RandomizedSearchCV, StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits


work = Path(".agent-runs/performance-v2")
datasets = {
    "breast": load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True),
    "digits": load_digits(return_X_y=True),
    "synthetic": make_classification(
        n_samples=800, n_features=20, n_informative=8, n_redundant=4, random_state=19
    ),
}
space = {"svc__C": loguniform(0.01, 100), "svc__gamma": loguniform(1e-4, 1)}
with threadpool_limits(limits=1), (work / "hpo-random-control.jsonl").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    for dataset, (X, y) in datasets.items():
        for seed in range(1001, 1009):
            train, test = train_test_split(
                np.arange(len(y)), test_size=0.25, stratify=y, random_state=seed
            )
            Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = X[train], X[test], y[train], y[test]
            folds = list(StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=seed).split(Xtr, ytr))
            started = time.perf_counter()
            search = RandomizedSearchCV(
                make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), SVC(kernel="rbf")),
                param_distributions=space,
                n_iter=72,
                cv=folds,
                scoring="accuracy",
                random_state=seed,
                n_jobs=1,
                error_score="raise",
            ).fit(Xtr, ytr)
            seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
            row = dict(
                dataset=dataset,
                seed=seed,
                seconds=seconds,
                candidate_cv_calls=len(search.cv_results_["mean_test_score"]),
                cv=float(search.best_score_),
                holdout=float(accuracy_score(yte, search.best_estimator_.predict(Xte))),
                params={key: float(value) for key, value in search.best_params_.items()},
            )
            stream.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
            stream.flush()
            print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
summary_script:
"""Freeze the paired, equal-budget HPO random-search control."""

import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import math
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


work = Path(".agent-runs/performance-v2")
ga_artifact = json.loads(Path("benchmarks/results/performance-v2/hpo-progress.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ga = {(row["dataset"], row["seed"]): row for row in ga_artifact["raw"]}
random = [json.loads(line) for line in (work / "hpo-random-control.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
by_key = {(row["dataset"], row["seed"]): row for row in random}
expected = {(dataset, seed) for dataset in ("breast", "digits", "synthetic") for seed in range(1001, 1009)}
assert len(random) == len(by_key) == len(expected) == len(ga) == 24
assert set(by_key) == set(ga) == expected
for row in random:
    assert row["candidate_cv_calls"] == 72
    assert math.isfinite(row["seconds"]) and row["seconds"] > 0
    assert 0 <= row["cv"] <= 1 and 0 <= row["holdout"] <= 1
    assert 0.01 <= row["params"]["svc__C"] <= 100
    assert 1e-4 <= row["params"]["svc__gamma"] <= 1

summary = []
for dataset in ("breast", "digits", "synthetic"):
    paired = [(ga[(dataset, seed)], by_key[(dataset, seed)]) for seed in range(1001, 1009)]
    deltas = [ga_row["final_holdout"] - random_row["holdout"] for ga_row, random_row in paired]
    summary.append(dict(
        dataset=dataset,
        ga_cv_mean=statistics.mean(a["final_cv"] for a, _ in paired),
        random_cv_mean=statistics.mean(b["cv"] for _, b in paired),
        ga_holdout_mean=statistics.mean(a["final_holdout"] for a, _ in paired),
        random_holdout_mean=statistics.mean(b["holdout"] for _, b in paired),
        heldout_delta_mean=statistics.mean(deltas),
        worst_ga_holdout_delta=min(deltas),
        ga_wins=sum(delta > 0 for delta in deltas),
        ties=sum(delta == 0 for delta in deltas),
        ga_losses=sum(delta < 0 for delta in deltas),
        ga_seconds_mean=statistics.mean(a["seconds"] for a, _ in paired),
        random_seconds_mean=statistics.mean(b["seconds"] for _, b in paired),
        mean_time_ratio=statistics.mean(a["seconds"] for a, _ in paired) / statistics.mean(b["seconds"] for _, b in paired),
        ga_cv_calls_mean=statistics.mean(a["candidate_cv_calls"] for a, _ in paired),
    ))

payload = dict(
    question="Does default GASearchCV beat a same-budget random hyperparameter search?",
    source_commit=subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    ga_artifact="benchmarks/results/performance-v2/hpo-progress.json",
    ga_raw_sha256=ga_artifact["raw_sha256"],
    settings=dict(
        datasets=["breast", "digits", "synthetic"], seeds=list(range(1001, 1009)),
        holdout_fraction=0.25, cv_folds=3, candidate_budget=72, cpu_threads=1,
        parameter_space=ga_artifact["settings"]["parameter_space"],
        model=ga_artifact["settings"]["model"],
        order="All GA searches were timed before all random searches; compare quality on paired splits, treat timing as descriptive.",
    ),
    environment={"python": platform.python_version(), **{name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ("numpy", "scikit-learn", "scipy", "deap")}},
    source_sha256=ga_artifact["source_sha256"],
    split_sha256=ga_artifact["split_sha256"],
    random_raw_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(random, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
    summary=summary,
    random_raw=random,
    reproduction_script=(work / "hpo-random-control.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
    summary_script=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
)
destination = Path("benchmarks/results/performance-v2/hpo-random-control.json")
destination.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
